messages:
sara: CI red on master — linux-release shard failing after last toolchain roll. failing target: //core/compile:libcore with undefined refs to __atomic_fetch_add_8. cc @devon @amir

ci-bot: Build failed for commit abc123 (merge of toolchain-update). logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/abc123

devon: Can someone try a quick local reproduce? `bazel build //core/compile:libcore --config=linux-release`

amir: Reproduced inside a docker gcc:11 image, same undefined refs. snippet:
```
ERROR: /src/core/compile/BUILD:23:1: Linking of rule '//core/compile:libcore' failed (Exit 1)
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/11/libgcc_s.a: undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

jen: Suspect `-latomic` is missing on the link line after the toolchain bump. @maya did the image/toolchain roll include any linker flag changes? :thinking_face:

maya: I rolled the gcc image yesterday and adjusted the toolchain wrapper to add `-march=native` for perf. I didn't intentionally drop -latomic. I'll look at the wrapper.

sara: Quick mitigation: can we add `linkopts = ["-latomic"]` to the //third_party/atomics target or to the //core/compile target as a short-term fix? Then we can run CI rerun to confirm.

devon: +1 to temporary `-latomic` patch and leave a FIXME comment to track. If this is widespread we should patch the toolchain wrapper instead.

maya: I'm opening a small PR to add `-latomic` to the failing targets and to add a note in the toolchain wrapper. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4829

ci-bot: Rerun queued by @maya for build abc123 -> https://ci.redwood/builds/abc123/rerun/9876

amir: If rerun still fails, I'll run a git bisect across the toolchain roll range (abc100..abc123) tonight: `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad abc100 abc123` and then `git bisect run ./scripts/ci-reproduce.sh`.

jen: Also leaving a note for oncall — if canary ingests traffic we might want to pause rollouts until this is fixed.

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll watch canary dashboards and pause the rollout if errors spike. Ping me if CI rerun fails. :white_check_mark:
